newsitem.title: UK: One July Forties deferred to Aug - trade.
newsitem.headline: One July Forties deferred to Aug - trade.

text.p: A cargo of North sea Forties loading July 29-31 has been deferred to August 11-13 due to production problems at the Nelson field, a trader said.
A second July Forties may also have been deferred or cancelled, he said. This could not immediately be confirmed.
Enterprise Oil, the operator of Nelson, is the equity holder of the 600,000 barrel, July 29-31 stem.
The shift of the cargo would mean a total of 44 Forties cargoes containing 26.45 million barrels would move in a revised August programme.
Earlier an Enterprise spokesman said crude production from Nelson field is likely to be cut back by around 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) on Friday due to problems with the gas system.
The spokesman said production was currently running about 10,000 bpd down at 130,000 bpd, but needed to be cut to around 70,000 bpd to prevent excess gas flaring. Full capacity is 160,000 bpd.
